translation:
SNU Grand Quest Academy Junior 2027: Call for Participants

In connection with 'SNU Grand Quest', promoted by our university, the 2027 Junior course of the SNU Grand Quest Academy, aimed at the next generation of scholars, will be run as follows.

A. Program name: "SNU Grand Quest Academy Junior"
※ What is the "SNU Grand Quest Academy"?
- An on-campus program that supports the thinking process through which the next generation of scholars explore questions from various perspectives and expand and develop them.
- Among these, the '2027 Junior course' is for undergraduate and master's students, and aims to help them learn how to structure and reinterpret questions.

B. Eligibility and number of participants: Undergraduate students and master's students; about 25 students will be selected.
- Includes students on leave of absence and students in the integrated master's-doctoral program who are within their first four semesters.
- Includes students who have completed master's coursework (provided no more than one semester has passed since completion).

C. Main schedule and content
- Starting from a single question, participants form teams with peers from other majors and perspectives and repeatedly develop it into new questions, thereby learning how to ask questions.

Orientation (1 day) ▶ Camp (3 days, 2 nights) ▶ Connect (1 day)
Preliminary exploration: Wednesday, 16 December 2026
Question inquiry: Wednesday, 6 January 2027 to Friday, 8 January 2027
Presentation of results: Wednesday, 24 March 2027

- An activity certificate and a certificate of completion will be issued upon completion of the entire program.
- Awards are planned for outstanding participants.

D. How and when to apply
- Application period: until Thursday, 5 November 2026.
- How to apply: apply individually on the SNU Grand Quest website (grandquest.snu.ac.kr); complete the application form and attach it.
- Selection results: applicants will be contacted individually during the second week of November.

E. Details: SNU Grand Quest website

F. Inquiries: the program's official email address (given in the original notice).
